$comment: Known-benign values that the secret scanner would otherwise report forever.
Every entry is keyed by the scanner's own fingerprint (sha256 of the value,
first 10 hex chars) so the secret itself is never written down here. Add an
entry only after reading the line with `git show <commit>:<path>` and
confirming it is a fixture, not a credential.
The scanner prints how many findings it suppressed, so this list cannot grow
quietly. Run with --no-allowlist to see everything again.
Nothing that matched a provider token pattern (AIza…, pplx-…, AKIA…,
mongodb+srv://user:pass@…) belongs here — those are always real findings.
